blocks.text: Sanati kimiyai tanseebat ko hadsaat rokne aur karkunon aur mahol ki hifazat ke liye sakht hifazati iqdamat chahiye. In mein shamil hain:

items: Karkun kimiyai maddon, hararat ya nuqsan-deh dhuen se chot se bachne ke liye zaati hifazati saaman (PPE) jaise dastane, chashme (goggles), helmets, lab coats aur hifazati joote use karein.

Kimiyai maddon par sahi label ho, aur unhein un ki khasiyaton ke mutabiq sambhala aur rakha jaye. Aag pakarne wale, zehreele ya corrosive maddey munasib dabbon aur alag godamon mein rakhe jayein taake rasao, girna, aaloodgi ya khatarnak reactions na hon.

Sanaton ke paas aag, kimiyai maddon ke girne, gas ke rasao ya dhamakon ke liye wazeh hangami mansoobe hon. Hangami darwaze, aag bujhane ke aale, first-aid kits aur girne wale maddey qaboo karne ka saaman maujood ho, aur karkun jante hon ke hangami halat mein kya karna hai.
Kaam ki jagah se zehreeli gases, dhuan aur gard nikalne ke liye achha hawa ka guzar (ventilation) zaruri hai; munasib hawa ka bahao nuqsan-deh maddey saans mein jane ka khatra kam karta hai.

Karkunon ko khatarnak maddey sambhalne aur saaman chalane ki munasib hifazati tarbiyat milni chahiye. Machines, pipelines aur zakhira tankon ki ba-qaida jaanch aur dekh-bhaal kharabiyan jaldi pakarti aur sanati hadsaat ka khatra kam karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan ki maeeshat ke (zaraat ke ilawa) do bare shobe batayein jo kimiyai sanat par bohat munhasir hain, aur har aik ke liye aik zaruri kimiyai product batayein.
blocks.explanation: Kapre ki sanat: caustic soda (neez masnoi dyes aur hydrogen peroxide). Tameerat: cement.

blocks.prompt: Kache tel ki alehdgi jis tabai usool par munhasir hai, use intermolecular forces aur boiling points ke lihaz se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Fractional distillation hydrocarbons ko boiling point se alag karti hai. Bare molecules ki intermolecular (London dispersion) forces zyada taqatwar hain, is liye boiling points zyada; yeh column mein neeche condense hote, jab ke chhote molecules zyada oopar ja kar condense hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Bohat se cosmetics aur khushbuon mein esters hote hain. Ester banane ke liye do qism ke reactants aur aam catalyst batayein.
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic acid aur alcohol; aam catalyst garha sulphuric acid hai.

blocks.prompt: Samjhayein ke garhe HNO3 jaise tez oxidising kimiyai maddey ethanol jaise aag pakarne wale organic maddon se alag kyun rakhe jayein.
blocks.explanation: Oxidising agent aag pakarne wale organic compound se tez, bohat exothermic redox reaction kar sakta hai, jo milne par (maslan girne ke baad) aag ya dhamaka shuru kar sakta hai.

items: Hifazat: PPE; sahi label aur alag zakhira; hangami mansoobe; ventilation; tarbiyat aur dekh-bhaal.
